map.由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金终值: Future Value of an Annuity Due from Periodic Payment, Rate and Periods
map.输入每期付款 PMT、每期利率 r、期数 n，求期初年金终值。: Enter periodic payment PMT, periodic rate r and periods n to find the annuity-due future value.
map.📖 查看「由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金终值 使用指南」: View "Future Value of an Annuity Due from Periodic Payment, Rate and Periods User Guide"
map.FV=PMT×[(1+r)^n−1]÷r×(1+r)，期初年金每笔付款多赚一期利: FV = PMT × [(1+r)^n − 1] ÷ r × (1+r); each annuity-due payment earns one extra period of interest, so FV = same-parameter ordinary annuity × (1+r). Applies to rent, insurance premiums and other beginning-of-period payment streams.
map.租金、保险等「期初付款」现金流的到期积累额。: The maturity accumulation of beginning-of-period payment streams such as rent and insurance.
map.每月月初定投的到期本息测算。: Estimate the maturity principal-plus-interest of a start-of-month recurring investment.
map.对比期初年金与期末: Compare the annuity due with the ordinary
map.每期 1,000、月利率 0.5%、12 期期初年金: 1,000 per period, monthly rate 0.5%, 12-period annuity due
map.期初年金和期末年金差多少？: How much does an annuity due differ from an ordinary annuity?
map.期初年金每笔付款多赚一期利息，终值=期末年金×(1+r)。长期定投差距会随期数放: Each annuity-due payment earns one extra period of interest, so FV = ordinary annuity × (1+r). The gap widens with more periods in long-term investing.
map.哪些现金流是期初年金？: Which cash flows are annuities due?
map.房租、保费、养老金缴费等多在期初支付，属期初年金；工资、利息多在期末，属普通年金: Rent, insurance premiums and pension contributions are mostly paid at the beginning and are annuities due; wages and interest are mostly at period end and are ordinary annuities.
